items.title: Player interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2012
items.q: speaking about my friend Mark Roe

ctx.x: How do you explain to someone who has no idea about the second line — I mean for instance I’ve only seen it on film. And sometimes I’m not sure what that is really all about.

Right. And you know I said this yesterday, speaking about my friend Mark Roe, who said to me once that New Orleans music is a feeling. And he is exactly right. And I think about the city that way. And so I was trying to convey that yesterday when I was speaking to the audience, is that I can try to explain it to you, but I know that I really can’t explain it to you. You have to participate in it. That’s what this music and the city is all about. You have to become engaged in it. And what I find is that I usually,…
You have to let go of your inhibitions, don’t you? To do that?
